description.en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA).

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** value as the **ClientToken** value. The **RequestId** value is different for each API request.

description.en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **ap-southeast-1**.

descriptions.zh:
在您调用本接口创建转发规则前，建议您先了解转发规则原理及匹配规则。更多信息，请参见[转发策略](~~204224~~)。

调用本接口时，请注意以下事项：


- **CreateForwardingRules**接口属于异步接口，即系统会先返回一个转发策略ID，但转发策略并未创建完成，系统后台的创建任务仍在进行。您可以调用[ListForwardingRules](~~205817~~)查询转发策略的状态：

    - 当转发策略处于**configuring**状态时，表示转发策略正在创建中，在该状态下，您只能执行查询操作，不能执行其他操作。

    - 当转发策略处于**active**状态时，表示转发策略创建完成。

- **CreateForwardingRules**接口不支持在同一个全球加速实例内并发创建转发策略。
descriptions.en:
Before you invoke this operation to create forwarding rules, we recommend that you understand the principles and matching rules of forwarding rules. For more information, see [Forwarding rules](~~204224~~).

Take note of the following items when you invoke this operation:


- **CreateForwardingRules** is an asynchronous operation. After you send a request, the system returns a forwarding rule ID but the forwarding rule is not yet created. The creation task continues to run in the background. You can invoke [ListForwardingRules](~~205817~~) to query the status of the forwarding rule:

    - If the forwarding rule is in the **configuring** state, the forwarding rule is being created. In this state, you can only execute query operations.

    - If the forwarding rule is in the **active** state, the forwarding rule is created.

- **CreateForwardingRules** does not support concurrent creation of forwarding rules within the same Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga create-forwarding-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 02fb3da40000 --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4q0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1s0vzbi5bxlx50000 --forwarding-rules '[{"RuleActions":[{"Order":20,"RuleActionType":"ForwardGroup","RuleActionValue":"type_:_endpointgroup_,_value_:_epg-bp1l49ltx6iengvf2ks5z0000","ForwardGroupConfig":{"ServerGroupTuples":["epg-bp1nktp3qgbcq9ih60000"]}}],"Priority":1,"ForwardingRuleName":"test","RuleConditions":[{"PathConfig":{"Values":["/test"]},"HostConfig":{"Values":["example.com"]},"RuleConditionType":"Host","RuleConditionValue":"www.example.com_,_www.aliyun.com"}],"RuleDirection":"request"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ga CreateForwardingRules --region cn-hangzhou --ForwardingRules.1.RuleActions.1.ForwardGroupConfig.ServerGroupTuples.1 'epg-bp1nktp3qgbcq9ih60000' --ForwardingRules.1.RuleActions.1.RuleActionValue 'type_:_endpointgroup_,_value_:_epg-bp1l49ltx6iengvf2ks5z0000' --ForwardingRules.1.RuleDirection request --ForwardingRules.1.RuleConditions.1.RuleConditionType Host --ForwardingRules.1.ForwardingRuleName test --ForwardingRules.1.RuleConditions.1.RuleConditionValue 'www.example.com_,_www.aliyun.com' --ForwardingRules.1.RuleConditions.1.HostConfig.Values.1 'example.com' --ForwardingRules.1.RuleActions.1.Order 20 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ForwardingRules.1.Priority 1 --ClientToken 02fb3da40000 --AcceleratorId 'ga-bp17frjjh0udz4q0000' --ForwardingRules.1.RuleConditions.1.PathConfig.Values.1 '/test' --ForwardingRules.1.RuleActions.1.RuleActionType ForwardGroup --ListenerId 'lsr-bp1s0vzbi5bxlx50000' --method POST --force
